question: Maximum C2 locus-raggedness tolerance
scope: Synthetic C2 plant only. C3-C9 were not run and no real frame was opened.

plant.raggedness_model: Original C2 model: Gaussian innovations -> cumulative random walk -> 17-sensor-column reflected moving average -> linear detrend -> exact RMS scaling.

sampling.paired_design: At each RMS, each noisy array is shared by both methods. Across RMS values, the same normalized displacement shapes and RNG seeds are reused at the requested new amplitude.
sampling.aggregation: Median of 2 noise fits per locus plant, then median across 64 independent locus plants.
sampling.scatter: 16th-84th percentiles and sample SD across the independent plant medians; bootstrap 95% CI for the median; split-half delta.

straight_line.description: One robust line from line_from_crossings; planted locus wander remains as ESF smear.

crossing.bar_definition: Absolute error of the median recovered fc across 64 independent locus plants, each itself the median of 2 noise realizations.
crossing.first_contiguous_failure: passes at 0.020, fails at 0.030 green px

measured_per_column.description: Each column is registered on its own measured 50% crossing; residual smear is crossing-estimation error, while same-column noise correlation can sharpen.

crossing.bar_definition: Absolute error of the median recovered fc across 64 independent locus plants, each itself the median of 2 noise realizations.

interpretation.requested_median_based_limit: 0.02 green px is the largest contiguous sampled RMS that passes; the first crossing is bracketed by 0.02 and 0.03 green px. Linear interpolation gives 0.0228 green px and is not claimed more precisely than the bracket.
interpretation.shape_scatter_warning: RMS alone does not guarantee a result for an individual locus: 52/64 plants pass at 0.01, 43/64 at 0.02, and 21/64 at 0.03 green px.
interpretation.isolated_reentry_warning: The apparent pass at 0.7 green px is not a tolerance extension. It occurs after a long failing interval, only 28/64 plants pass, its 16th-84th error range is -7.05% to 18.68%, and it is bias cancellation between an initially high fitted cutoff and later raggedness smear.
interpretation.per_column_result: Per-column registration fails before raggedness is introduced: at 0.00 green px it leaves only 0.668 um median residual smear but biases fc by +91.047%. The failure is self-registration sharpening, not untracked locus smear.

answer_c: The pipeline needs a straighter subject. Measured per-column self-registration does not extend the contiguous 5% tolerance.
